tools.name: get_equipment_record
tools.description: Read the FieldCare equipment record for one confirmed equipment_id. Use it to verify model, site, warranty-status label, configuration, and support scope before combining documents with service data.

equipment_id.description: Confirmed equipment unique identifier such as EQ-FC-1001.

tools.result_contract: Returns status, data, message, error_type, source_id, and retrieved_at. data is one equipment row when status is found.
safe_use_rules: If the model is unsupported, abstain from model-specific repair instructions and route to the legacy owner.

tools.name: get_warranty_status
tools.description: Read the current warranty and service-eligibility state for one equipment_id. Use this before answering whether a visit, part, or labor is covered.

service_date.description: Optional ISO date for the service event being checked.

tools.result_contract: Returns coverage_state, labor_coverage, parts_coverage, exclusions, confidence, and recommended_next_step inside data when status is found.
safe_use_rules: Warranty answers must come from this tool, not from policy text alone.
If status is unavailable or permission_denied, route to Warranty Operations.

tools.name: get_maintenance_history
tools.description: Read recent maintenance events for one equipment_id, optionally filtered by issue category. Use it when prior visits, repeat faults, replaced parts, or unresolved work can change the answer.

issue_category.description: Optional issue family such as overheating, airflow_restriction, or sensor_fault.

tools.result_contract: Returns most recent matching maintenance events in reverse chronological order.
safe_use_rules: Use history together with current ticket state before recommending escalation.
Do not treat a closed past visit as proof that the current issue is resolved.

tools.name: get_ticket_status
tools.description: Read the current status, priority, escalation state, and next action for one confirmed ticket_id. Use it when urgency, ownership, or current workflow state matters.
tools.result_contract: Returns one service ticket row when found.
safe_use_rules: Current ticket state must come from this tool, not from maintenance history alone.
If a ticket is missing, ask for the ticket_id or equipment_id before closing or escalating.

tools.name: search_service_docs
tools.description: Search current FieldCare service documentation. Use it to retrieve troubleshooting, safety, escalation, parts, and policy evidence before drafting an answer.
tools.result_contract: Returns ranked evidence rows with doc_id, chunk_id, title, score, current flag, and preview.
safe_use_rules: If legacy or superseded documents appear, prefer current documents and label outdated evidence.
Do not use retrieved text as a warranty system of record.

tools.name: recommend_escalation_path
tools.description: Recommend the FieldCare handoff path for a confirmed equipment_id, ticket_id, and reason_code. This is a routing recommendation, not an action that closes or transfers a ticket.
tools.result_contract: Returns recommended team, priority note, and what evidence should be attached.
safe_use_rules: This tool recommends a path but does not perform the handoff.
